correctness.rationale: The exact three-projector spectral decomposition holds for all positive spoke couplings, common leaf potential and arbitrary real central detuning. The Schur-square block formula follows directly. A nonstandard projector-compression lemma proves leaf-block strict positivity for at least three spokes; low-dimensional determinant and rank boundaries are derived exactly. Replayed checks: 315 rational ranks, 405 independent eigendecompositions, 17280 entry comparisons (maximum discrepancy 1.221e-15). Finite computations are not the proof.

evidence: Carlson et al. study instantaneous universal mixing of edge-weighted stars, not infinite-time Cesàro average-mixing rank.

Kimmerling explicitly identifies a proof of full average-mixing rank for ordinary unweighted star graphs, but her accessible abstract does not claim arbitrary unequal couplings or detuned hub potentials.

originality.rationale: The general commutant and exact-projector methods are known, and full rank for a standard unweighted star was previously established. None of the inspected primary sources states the robust arbitrary-spoke, arbitrary-hub-detuning classification or the precise two-spoke determinant. Relevant prior statements and implications, not mere titles, were compared; access to the 2023 dissertation full text is a specifically disclosed residual risk.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the long-time mixing rank for an important central-site network model: the exact minimal active channel threshold for uniform-in-parameters positive definiteness, and the precise exceptional hypersurfaces for one or two channels. The robust arbitrary-spoke conclusion is not a renaming of known uniform-weight star results; the proof produces the full matrix and physically meaningful coupling/detuning failure mechanisms. It does not claim an instantaneous-uniformity corollary.
